messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- The authentication gateway is not Team Ember's service. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- Every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-11]
- The security audit flagged long-lived authentication gateway tokens. [valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour as of 2026-01-27. [decision; valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-17 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-10 that the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-10]
- Cinder observed at standup on 2026-04-17 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-17]
- Billing-api depends on the flags service as of 2025-10-21. [valid 2025-10-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-21]
- The authentication gateway went to team Boreal as of 2025-07-01, not the Cinder team; Cinder never owned it. [decision; valid 2025-07-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01. [decision; valid 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-18; recorded by handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-07-01; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- The webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind the flags service so the rollout has a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-10-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-21]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- The webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-16]
- As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly. [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- The reports pipeline is not a Boreal service. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-06]
